property_summary: For any value, a call to SetMinSum(_val) succeeds and sets MinSum to _val; in the mutant the nonReentrant_ modifier requires locked_==true, so SetMinSum always reverts and MinSum stays 0.
change_summary: Replace `require(!locked_);` with `require(locked_);` so every nonReentrant_ function, including SetMinSum, reverts when called normally, keeping MinSum at its initial value.
